_comment: Every value here was read off the chain or a canonical doc page, not assumed. scripts/probe.mjs re-verifies the whole file; run it before trusting any of it.

USDG.role: payments unit. The USDC of this chain, and 6 decimals like USDC, so raw-unit caps mean what they look like.

GROKBLOCK.role: project token. Not used by the contracts — the vault neither holds nor requires it.

dex._comment: Verified deployed (24,546 bytes) on 2026-09-01. TRAP: this is a MODIFIED Uniswap UniversalRouter fork with an extra minHopPriceX36 field in its v4 swap struct, so standard Uniswap SDK calldata REVERTS against it. Robinhood documents that two look-alike routers also exist on this chain and only this address is correct. Nothing here uses it yet.
dex.verified: code present; ABI compatibility NOT tested

deployment._comment: The payment and the first two swaps ran against an EARLIER vault; the address above is the current one, redeployed to add swapWithSig. Old vaults were drained before replacement.

testnet._tokensComment: USDG and WETH are MAINNET-ONLY: both mainnet addresses have no code on 46630, confirmed by eth_getCode. A testnet payment run therefore needs a token deployed here first — a mock 6-decimal ERC-20 is enough to exercise the module, and it must never be described as USDG.

erc4337._comment: All three EntryPoint versions have code on mainnet. v0.7 is the target: v0.6 is legacy, v0.8 is new enough that tooling lags.

unverified: Whether any third-party ERC-4337 bundler serves this chain. It does not block anything: the relayer submits transactions directly, so no bundler is required.
The native gas token and its price. Needed before any paymaster deposit sizing.
What token, if any, testnet 46630 offers for payments. The probe found none at the mainnet addresses, so plan on deploying a mock.
Whether the modified UniversalRouter can be driven from a vault-owned swap intent. Its calldata is non-standard, so this needs a simulated swap before any claim that trading works.
